uncertainties: The complete179 past Mage inventory and the84 Arcane inventory are retained. This package does not bind either incomplete source pool or create Standard deck roots.

Cone of Cold freezes the original physical adjacent living minions, then damages surviving original references in one shared batch. Meteor damages original target15 and immediate physical neighbors4 in one batch; locations/dormant occupants do not cause farther replacement neighbors.

Soulfreeze captures original active targets and pays damage to the caster hero equal to that original count after guarded freezes. Already-frozen targets count; freeze prevention or intervening reactions do not recalculate this local count. Exact affected-count, spell-power and CN window differences remain unconfirmed.

Breath of Sindragosa uses the existing finite random-effect producer over complete original enemy minion references, followed by guarded damage and guarded freeze. Reentry/control/face changes use existing strict MinionReference policy; exact official transformation boundaries remain deferred.

Snap Freeze and Ray of Frost branch on the initial current frozen flag; no new freeze is applied by their already-frozen destruction/damage branch. Ray uses the actual DAL_577ts terminal Twinspell face through shared HandDerivativeSpec.

Brain Freeze uses the existing spell-native Combo keyword and original spell_conditions.combo fact. It freezes the captured target and, for that accepted condition, applies3 spell damage to the original reference. Automatic casts retain existing automatic Combo policy; minion-only independent Combo repeat providers are not expanded by this card.

Deep Freeze summons the original CS2_033 from its raw related dbf395; Flame Geyser adds original UNG_809t1 dbf42044. Mirror Image uses original CS2_mirror dbf968 with explicit zero cost/attack normalization from both official faces. Existing SW_108t is not overwritten.

Lifelong removal uses the existing nondeath RemoveFromGame interpreter; Fire Sale uses a real Tradeable hand action. Ripple uses the existing minion spell-damage grant. Summon capacity/quantity, full-hand burn, death, freeze and exact CN reaction timing retain shared local policies.
